_about: Feature labels for the explorer. transcoder: Gemma Scope 2 transcoders (16k features per layer, l0_small), key L<layer>.<feature>. sae17: layer-17 residual SAE (16k, l0_medium). neurons: MLP neurons <layer>.<index>. Labels are best guesses written by an LLM from Gemma Scope example texts and the project's own prompts; they are not proofs.

sources.atlas: Persona-atlas labels (250 features that differed between conditions in the project's corpus; with notes)
sources.v16: Later labels for features seen in the showcase prompts (high/medium confidence only; 'unclear' dropped)
sources.gemmascope: No project label: the snippet and promoted tokens come from Gemma Scope's example texts
